verdict.rationale: Figma Make is a SaaS app-building platform, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such reference: probes for OpenAPI and Swagger specs all returned 404, and a community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, so users had to reverse-engineer the format. Code exploration and editing of generated apps is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
